title: Elon Musk invests US$366 million in Republicans for the midterms
seoTitle: Elon Musk invests $366M in GOP for 2026 midterms
subtitle: The American billionaire becomes the largest individual donor of the 2026 election cycle
excerpt: Elon Musk, CEO of Tesla and SpaceX, donated US$366 million (R$1.8 billion) to support the Republican Party in the 2026 midterm elections, solidifying his position.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: G1, Folha de S.Paulo, CNN Brasil
contentHtml:
Elon Musk, CEO of Tesla and SpaceX, donated US$366 million (R$1.8 billion) to support the Republican Party in the 2026 midterm elections, solidifying his position as the largest individual donor of the cycle.

Total Donation and Distribution

  • US$158 million to the Senate Leadership Fund, the main super PAC supporting Republican candidates in the Senate;
  • US$20 million to the Congressional Leadership Fund, which supports candidates in the House;
  • US$76 million to America PAC, a super PAC created by Musk in 2024 to mobilize voters;
  • US$10 million to the Lone Star Liberty PAC, which supports Republican candidate Ken Paxton for Senate in Texas;
  • US$10 million to the Republican Governors Association;
  • US$2 million to the Republican Attorneys General Association.

Impact on Midterm Elections

With this money, the Republican Party gained a financial advantage in the midterm races, which will take place on November 3, 2026, renewing the House of Representatives and about one-third of the Senate.

Political and Historical Context

Musk had previously donated US$290 million in 2024 to help Donald Trump and the Republicans. In May 2025, he stated that he had “done enough” in political spending, but the latest wave of donations shows a renewed commitment to the right.

International Reaction and Interpretations

International news outlets interpreted the donation as an offensive against Democrats who are calling for investigations into SpaceX contracts and Musk's actions during the Donald Trump administration. The initiative was also seen as part of an effort to preserve Republican control in Congress.

Connections with Trump and the Government

Musk had a disagreement with Trump upon leaving his government position, but the two have reconciled. Trump awarded Musk the National Medal of Science last week, and the billionaire has rejoined an advisory role in a study on the future of warfare.

Conclusion

Musk's donation demonstrates the role of large fortunes in American politics, especially in midterm elections, where control of Congress can be decisive for the future of the United States.

With information from G1, Folha de S.Paulo, CNN Brasil.
